## Subject

What repository object or product surface is governed?

## Intent

What outcome is required, and what is explicitly out of scope?

## Contract

What must remain true or intentionally change?

## Acceptance

Which observable conditions define completion?

## Evidence

Which `ethos ...` commands should prove completion?
